observations: Three photos show a used car engine from different angles, lying on a concrete surface.
The engine has a black plastic valve cover with visible wear, dirt, and some white residue or paint on it.
There are four visible fuel injectors on top of the engine.
The intake manifold is black plastic, and the exhaust manifold is rusty metal.
The engine block is metallic and shows signs of oil residue and grime.
Various hoses, wires, and connectors are attached, some appearing aged or cracked.
No visible branding or model numbers on the engine block or valve cover in any photo.
The seller's text includes a location in Mushin, Lagos, but no mention of the engine's make, model, or condition beyond the photos.
